messages:
marta: Heads-up — nightly eval 2234 flagged a sharp uptick in empty/short generations on summarization prompts (summ-devset). Metric: accept_rate down from 0.87 -> 0.62 since the INT8+FP8 precision profile rollout.
eval-bot: nightly-run 2234 finished: model=llama4-mini-quantized profile=precision-stitcher-v2 job=nr-2234-summ-devset accept_rate=0.62 recall@5=0.71 (was 0.89) empty_generations=4.8% (was 0.3%) 
CI: failing tests: summaries/truncate-check x12. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2234
deepak: :eyes: first guess — calibration/quant-scale mismatch on prefix layers. I saw similar when layerwise clip changed but kernel selection still used old int8 scales.
jason: Repro locally with --seed=42? I tried a small subset and got a few null outputs too. Command I ran:
```
python eval/harness.py --model=llama4-mini --profile=precision-stitcher-v2 --dataset=summ-devset --limit=500
```
Got 2 empty outputs in 200.
sophia: Noting that precision-stitcher-v2 does dynamic stitching: int8 for early layers, fp8 mid/late. Could be a failure when the runtime switches execution kernels mid-forward and KV cache mapping diverges.
marta: Good point. Logs show repeated warning at step ~25: `kv_cache_mismatch: expected 512 got 0` — appears in ~30% of empty cases.
deepak: That's suspicious. If kv position resets, generation can return BOS only. Can we check whether the calibration snapshot used for int8 had a different tokenization or vocab mapping? Unlikely but must rule out.
jason: I dumped token ids for failing traces. Example: `input_ids: [101, 523, 12] -> generated_ids: []` (empty). In a separate good run: `generated_ids: [102, 45, ...]`. So decoder never stepped.
sophia: I opened runtime traces: kernel boundary crossing logs show `stitch_point=layer_10` then an `alloc_zero` call on kv buffer followed by `compute_attn` returning early. Looks like an allocator bug when switching to fp8 path.
marta: Assigning triage: deepak take runtime/kernel trace, jason gather failing sample IDs + seeds, sophia check allocator/kv codepath and recent kernel changes. I'll file a short issue and pin.
ci-bot: Created issue #INFR-1729: "precision-stitcher: intermittent empty generation due to kv cache zeroing at kernel boundary" — linked to run 2234.
jason: Quick mitigation possibility — revert to all-int8 or all-fp8 profiles for the nightly until root cause found. Can we toggle profile at rollout config? @marta
marta: Yes — we can flip the default profile for nightly to `precision-stitcher-v1` (all-int8) in config. Doing a canary now for next job.
sophia: Also adding a small patch: add an assertion after kernel-copy to ensure kv_size matches expected and fail loudly instead of returning empty token.
deepak: For deeper repro I'll run a fuzz on stitch points: run the harness with `--force-stitch=layer_{8..14}` to see where it breaks.
jason: I'll share failing sample list in the issue (ids + seeds + trimmed inputs). preliminary pattern: longer-context prompts (>=320 tokens) see higher empty rate.
marta: Note for postmortem: quantify user impact (hosted traffic?), schedule rollback if it affects prod. Good catch, team. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: nightly-run 2235 queued with profile precision-stitcher-v1 (canary) — job id nr-2235 (watch: https://ci.internal/runs/2235)
